action.description: Operation to perform. Use setup_create to create or reuse OpenCTO's AgentMail-backed AgentEmail inbox.

inbox_id.description: AgentMail inbox ID for message operations. Use an empty string when not known or not relevant.

display_name.description: Display name for setup_create. Use an empty string to let OpenCTO choose a default.

username.description: Optional local-part username for setup_create. Use an empty string to let OpenCTO choose a stable generated username.

domain.description: Optional AgentMail domain for setup_create. Use an empty string for AgentMail's default domain.

query.description: Full-text search query for search_messages or wait_for_message. Use an empty string when not relevant.

message_id.description: Message ID for read_message. Use an empty string when not relevant.

from.description: Sender substring filter for list_messages or wait_for_message. Use an empty string for no sender filter.

to.description: Recipients for send_message, or recipient substring filters for list_messages/wait_for_message. Use an empty array when not relevant.

cc.description: CC recipients for send_message. Use an empty array when not relevant.

bcc.description: BCC recipients for send_message. Use an empty array when not relevant.

reply_to.description: Reply-To addresses for send_message. Use an empty array when not relevant.

subject.description: Subject for send_message, or subject substring filter for list_messages/wait_for_message. Use an empty string when not relevant.

text.description: Plain text body for send_message. Use an empty string when not sending a message.

html.description: HTML body for send_message. Use an empty string when not sending HTML.

limit.description: Maximum messages or inboxes to return. Use 0 for the tool default.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait time for wait_for_message. Use 0 for the tool default.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Polling interval for wait_for_message. Use 0 for the tool default.
